old_en:
Using bugs caused by the player themselves to gain unintended advantages is considered a violation.
* Using agent skills
* Prohibited from placing Cypher's camera in invisible or impassable locations through map texture penetration
* Prohibited from using skills outside the map boundaries (Out of boundaries) to gather information or gain an advantage
* Exception: KAY/O's ZERO/POINT skill can be used outside the map or on destructible locations, but the blade is prohibited from penetrating textures that should be solid.
* Jumping onto teammates: Prohibited from using teammates' characters to jump to heights exceeding normal jump range.
Penalties
Officials will assess penalties based on intent and impact.
